text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gugigigiii...! I got beaten to a pulp, I 
did~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess! Such an unseemly defeat 
is simply out of the question!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I should've been able to do more...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeek! I am utterly ashamed of 
myself~~!!
choice_data_list:
You did so well, you really gave it your 
all!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... You're the one who was working even 
harder than me, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I wanted so badly to live up 
to those expectations, and yet, ending up 
with a result like this..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No... I have to live up to it from here on 
out. Next time, I will redeem myself...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! My princess mentality has made a full 
recovery!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...You are quite right. Oh, what a 
petty-minded thing for me to do!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"At times like this—waterfall training is 
the answer! Let us wash away all weakness 
of heart in the raging torrent!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Eh♪ In the Puri-Fi series, a waterfall 
meditation episode whenever the princess 
is lost in thought is an absolute classic!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we searched for a waterfall 
where she could meditate— and she stood 
right under the cascading water without 
delay.
